title: Guest play fix is not yet verified through the real iPhone user flow
reproduction: Open the deployed KELO WORLD page from a fresh mobile session.
Use the visible Jugar como invitado flow rather than importing internal modules.
Verify the auth gate closes and does not reopen.
Verify gameplay remains available as Guest.
expected: A player can choose Guest, enter gameplay, and remain in the game without the auth gate reappearing.
actual: Guest/session fixes exist in main, but the current real-iPhone automation does not prove the complete visible Guest flow because the BrowserStack context fails before the page is tested.
evidence: Commit 4da93131c1e617168ee904483d4fe1d00cf0f3a8: feat(auth): enable guest play for AI testing
Commit 2c5e55ced94129e8cbe756bbbec503b8705cf37c: feat(auth): load guest play bypass
Commit 92d36bcf4e8ebfaa54f578f2ea608cb1ed2b43b0: fix(auth): keep valid guest sessions inside the game
src/auth/guest-play-bypass.js supports explicit ?guest=1 / ?aiGuest=1 plus valid anonymous sessions

fix.summary: Guest bypass/session handling was added and valid anonymous Guest sessions are intended to stay inside gameplay.

verification.method: Fresh real iPhone Safari E2E: visible auth -> tap Jugar como invitado -> gameplay -> auth gate remains closed.

notes: The existing World reopen test opens Creator Hub programmatically and therefore is not sufficient proof of the human Guest entry flow.
Do not promote to VERIFIED solely from local/desktop tests.
